blocks.text: CEBU CITY – An anti-Trump and anti-Pax Silica rally along Colon Street in Cebu City turned tense on Monday after a confrontation between protesters and police left two police officers with minor injuries. The demonstration, organized by several progressive groups opposing the planned visit of United States President Donald Trump and the proposed Pax Silica initiative, escalated after protesters burned an effigy, police here said. Approximately 400 to 450 protesters, including students from various schools and universities here, joined Monday’s series of rallies, which included marches from Fuente Osmena Circle to Colon Street that began around 9 a.m. READ: UP seeks […]...
